art_direction_consistency.evidence: JoGo board palette, mascot, robot, rounded material language and local type are consistent across home, play, repair and results.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Repaired after user feedback: the responsive tableau viewport enlarges revealed working, active digits are visibly bounded, and the prompt, workbench and gates read in that order at 1024x768.

typography_readability.evidence: Repaired after user feedback: faint quotient dots were replaced by 40-unit answer slots, the active unknown uses dark navy on yellow, maths glyphs render at 34 SVG units, and close-up evidence was visually inspected.

layout_spacing.evidence: Strict landscape overflow assertions and portrait horizontal-overflow checks pass.

character_object_quality.evidence: Approved high-resolution Mr Jo and robot assets retain clear silhouettes at home, play and results sizes.

touch_usability.evidence: Gate and control targets exceed 44px; Pointer Events path completed under touch-enabled browser context.

input_responsiveness.evidence: Pointer selection, keyboard steering, Enter commit, pause and restart all change state immediately.

motion_transitions.evidence: Gate travel and lane motion communicate state; reduced-motion mode removes non-essential travel.

correct_answer_feedback.evidence: Success feedback names the completed equation and writes the value into the tableau.

mistake_recovery_feedback.evidence: Progressive clue identifies the relationship, preserves the item and requires repair.

audio_integration.evidence: Distinct WebAudio success, mistake and finish cues with persistent mute; silent play remains complete.

performance_smoothness.evidence: Static DOM/SVG/CSS build, local assets, no runtime fetch failures, and stable automated interaction.

first_ten_seconds.evidence: Objective, operation sequence, pace and Start action fit in the first 1024x768 viewport.

restart_replay_flow.evidence: Restart and Next Route produce step zero, zero score and a playable state.

educational_clarity.evidence: 18/20 pre-build score, passed Removal Test, visible operation rail, deterministic tableau and transfer-focused results.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard path, focus-visible styles, live region, semantic buttons/dialogs, non-colour labels and reduced motion.

crash_free_core_loop.evidence: Browser QA completed all representative states with no console, page, request or HTTP errors.

learning_content_preserved.evidence: Long-division sequence and six baseline content problems are represented in the rebuilt engine.

keyboard_and_pointer.evidence: Both paths advanced verified mathematical steps.

pause_and_restart.evidence: Pause/resume and clean restart assertions passed.

responsive_geometry.evidence: 1024x768 landscape has no page overflow; 820x1180 portrait has no horizontal overflow; browser bounds assert quotient/bar and bar/dividend clearance.

critical_thresholds.evidence: Every critical category meets or exceeds its threshold.

no_high_issues.evidence: No critical or high-severity issue remains after the final rendered pass.

open_issues.issue: Physical Safari/iPad touch testing remains outstanding before public publication.
